project.name: testNET
project.description: Java OS (JNode-derived) networking test suite: Ethernet (AMD Lance/PCnet) driver, IPv4/DHCP networking, TCP/IP test servers, and NFS client tests, built as a NetBeans Ant project with JUnit tests.

nodes.name: LanceFinder.java
nodes.summary: DeviceFinder implementation that locates AMD Lance/PCnet NICs on the PCI bus. It looks up core system services (Ports, IRQ, MemoryManager, CPUManager) via Naming, polls for the PCIAccess access point, and scans PCI network-class devices for the AMD vendor ID 0x1022 with device ID 0x2000 (Am79C970).
nodes.languageNotes: Wildcard imports (jx.zero.*, jx.devices.pci.*); imports LanceDriver and LanceFlags from org.jnode.driver.net.lance.

nodes.name: LanceFinder
nodes.summary: Implements DeviceFinder to discover AMD PCnet Ethernet controllers. Defines NIC vendor/device ID constants, holds references to system services, and both finds and instantiates LanceDriver objects for supported NICs.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: DeviceFinder.find entry point. Looks up Ports, IRQ, MemoryManager and CPUManager from Naming, then busy-waits (with Thread.yield) until the PCIAccess access point is available, and delegates to findDevice.
nodes.languageNotes: Overrides DeviceFinder.find; Debug.out used for logging.

nodes.name: findDevice
nodes.summary: Queries the PCI bus for network-class devices and filters for the AMD vendor ID, accepting device ID 0x2000 (Am79C970). For a supported NIC it allocates 10 frame buffers and returns an array containing a new LanceDriver configured with a LanceFlags('test') instance.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses AdapterLimits.ETHERNET_MAXIMUM_FRAME_SIZE from metaxa.os.devices.net for buffer sizing.

nodes.name: LanceDriver.java
nodes.summary: NetworkDevice implementation driving the AMD Lance/PCnet NIC. Wraps a LanceCore, creates CPU events for interrupt/send/receive, manages a MultiThreadBufferList of usable buffers, and exposes transmit, transmit1, getMACAddress, getMTU, consumer registration, and open/close lifecycle methods.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements jx.devices.net.NetworkDevice (external interface). Several methods are stubs throwing UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: LanceDriver
nodes.summary: Public driver class implementing NetworkDevice for the AMD Lance/PCnet NIC. Holds a LanceCore device core, event ids for interrupt/send/receive, a usable-buffer list, and an ethernet consumer for receive callbacks.

nodes.name: LanceDriver
nodes.summary: Constructor. Stores MemoryManager/CPUManager, builds the LanceCore via newCore, creates 'Lanceinterrupt'/'LanceSnd'/'LanceRcv' CPU events, and wraps the supplied buffers in a MultiThreadBufferList2 with recording enabled.
nodes.languageNotes: Takes LanceFlags (from this batch) and jx.zero service interfaces.

nodes.name: newCore
nodes.summary: Factory method creating the LanceCore for this driver, passing the driver, device, flags, irq, ports and memory manager. Protected so subclasses can override core creation.
nodes.languageNotes: Target LanceCore is in the project but outside this batch; no edge emitted.

nodes.name: setReceiveMode
nodes.summary: NetworkDevice.setReceiveMode override that is currently an empty stub (receive mode handling not implemented).
nodes.languageNotes: Empty body; original UnsupportedOperationException commented out.

nodes.name: transmit
nodes.summary: Transmits a memory buffer by delegating to abstractDeviceCore.transmit, swallowing InterruptedException, and always returning null.

nodes.name: transmit1
nodes.summary: Transmits a region of a buffer with offset/size handling. Records the event_snd event, undocks a buffer from usableBufs (returning buf1 if none available), copies the payload into a freshly allocated buffer, and delegates the copy to abstractDeviceCore.transmit.

nodes.name: getMACAddress
nodes.summary: Returns the MAC address bytes from the underlying LanceCore hardware address.

nodes.name: getMTU
nodes.summary: Returns the Ethernet MTU, a constant ETH_DATA_LEN of 1500 octets.

nodes.name: registerNonBlockingConsumer
nodes.summary: Registers a single NonBlockingMemoryConsumer for receive callbacks, throwing an Error if a consumer is already registered.

nodes.name: getSupportedConfigurations
nodes.summary: NetworkDevice.getSupportedConfigurations stub that always throws UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Opens the device by calling abstractDeviceCore.initialize().

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: NetworkDevice.close stub with an empty body; close behavior not implemented.

nodes.name: onReceive
nodes.summary: Receive callback: hands the received memory buffer to the registered etherConsumer via processMemory and kicks the consumer thread.

nodes.name: getId
nodes.summary: NetworkDevice.getId stub that always throws UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: LanceFlags.java
nodes.summary: Configuration flags container for the Lance/PCnet driver. Holds the device name, chip name, full-duplex, auto-select and must-unreset settings, with setForVersion mapping chip version codes to human-readable PCnet chip names.
nodes.languageNotes: Simple data class with getters; a version of it exists in original JNode core.

nodes.name: LanceFlags
nodes.summary: Immutable-ish flag holder for the Lance NIC driver: name, chip name, fullDuplex, autoSelectEnabled, mustUnreset. Only setForVersion mutates chipName/fullDuplex based on chip version.

nodes.name: LanceFlags
nodes.summary: Constructor initializing name to the given string, chipName to 'Unknown', and fullDuplex/autoSelectEnabled/mustUnreset to false.

nodes.name: setForVersion
nodes.summary: Maps a chip version integer to a PCnet chip name and full-duplex flag (0x2420-0x2627 range), defaulting to 'no device !' for unknown versions. Comments note the flags are incomplete and unused by LanceCore.
nodes.languageNotes: Large switch statement over chip version codes.

nodes.name: isFullDuplex
nodes.summary: Returns whether full-duplex mode is enabled.

nodes.name: isMustUnreset
nodes.summary: Returns whether the device must be unreset.

nodes.summary: NetBeans-generated Ant build implementation containing macrodefs and targets for initialization, compilation (with module/processor support), JAR creation, execution, debugging, Javadoc generation, test compilation/execution (JUnit 4 and TestNG), profiling, and cleanup. Defines the complete build lifecycle for the testNET project.
nodes.languageNotes: XML with Ant macros and NetBeans-specific namespaces; generated from project.xml — do not edit directly
